headline: Linn of Mercy Re-Ignites as Island and Valley Fronts Churn
war_summary: Since the morning dispatch, Linn of Mercy has abruptly re-ignited, recording eight strategic base exchanges within the past two hours centered on Lathair and Outwich Ranch after earlier falling completely quiet. Godcrofts remains engulfed in relentless island fighting, posting eleven base transactions over the same span as Isawa, Fleecewatch, and Ursa Base change hands, leaving three positions in ruins. The grinding struggle across Marban Hollow persists with six fresh transfers dividing Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, while Palantine Berm logged four exchanges alongside sharply accelerating casualties at Vendett and Windburn Landing. Further east, Stlican Shelf continues to yield immense butcher's bills—surpassing twenty-two hundred casualties in two hours—with contested ground lingering at Breaker Town. Although Weathered Expanse saw base transfers stall, fierce fighting has reignited there and in Callahan's Passage, accompanied by mounting losses along the Farranac Coast where Transient Valley remains embattled.
